en.summary: The leaders of the United States and China are meeting to discuss trade, artificial intelligence, Taiwan, and the Iran conflict among other issues.

stories.title: Delcy promete ante la ONU que habrá elecciones, pero que ella asumirá la transición política

en.title: Delcy promises at the UN that there will be elections, but she will lead the political transition
en.summary: Venezuela's interim president announced at the UN General Assembly that elections will occur but stated she will oversee the political transition process.

stories.title: Trump agasaja a Xi Jinping con un recibimiento militar a pie de pista en Washington

en.title: Trump welcomes Xi Jinping with a military reception at Washington airport
en.summary: President Trump gave Chinese President Xi Jinping an unusual personal welcome at a military airport near Washington to begin a state visit aimed at easing tensions between the superpowers.

stories.title: Delcy Rodríguez en la ONU: "en Venezuela habrá elecciones, pero una elección debe ser una solución no un generador de conflictos irreconciliables"

en.title: Delcy Rodríguez at the UN: "in Venezuela there will be elections, but an election must be a solution not a generator of irreconcilable conflicts"
en.summary: Venezuela's interim president told the UN General Assembly that elections will take place and stated she will guide the country from uncertainty toward full democracy, without specifying timelines.

stories.title: Delcy Rodríguez agradece a Trump su papel en Venezuela y asegura que habrá elecciones sin concretar la fecha

en.title: Delcy Rodríguez thanks Trump for his role in Venezuela and assures that there will be elections without specifying the date
en.summary: Venezuela's president returned to the UN General Assembly, where she criticized the United States without mentioning Maduro, who is imprisoned near UN headquarters. She thanked Trump for his involvement in Venezuelan affairs while stating elections will occur without providing specific timing.

stories.title: Zapatero ocultó en su declaración como expresidente las joyas que asegura que recibió del Rey de Arabia Saudí

en.title: Zapatero hid jewelry he claims he received from Saudi Arabian King in his declaration as former president
en.summary: Former Spanish president José Luis Rodríguez Zapatero declared over 500 gifts received during his presidency in 2012, but omitted three jewelry sets comprising rubies, emeralds and sapphires allegedly gifted by Saudi King Abdullah in 2007, which are now under investigation.

stories.title: Sánchez responsabiliza a Ayuso y Almeida del desahucio de Maricarmen

en.summary: Spanish President Pedro Sánchez addressed the eviction of an 87-year-old woman from her Madrid home at the UN General Assembly, attributing responsibility to Madrid's regional government and city administration for the displacement.

en.summary: The U.S. Treasury Secretary announced that the United States and China have extended their commercial truce by two additional months until January, during what appears to be a significant diplomatic meeting between the two leaders.

stories.title: Sánchez culpa a Ayuso y Almeida de la “tragedia social” del desahucio de Maricarmen
